summary: Humeston's own site confirms 13 full hookups (count 14->13, adds water/sewer); says nothing on rate, booking or operator. No fees written.
flags: WEBSITE: entry has none; add https://www.humestoniowa.com/area-attractions, the town site's listing and its only web presence I found. It reads as a community site; the operator isn't named.

WHO RUNS IT / public booking: 'city-run' and 'call to reserve' in the note rest on the earlier sweep. No page I read says who runs it or how a night is booked. Campendium calls it a county park, which the note rejects. Rate $20 in the note is unsourced too; the town has a web page, so no camper-report fallback. Phone 641-877-6841 matches listings only.
Waterfront none. Imagery: angled pull-in slots about 80 m east of the pin; pin fine.
LEAD, not vetted: the same page lists Humeston's 'Lakeside Camping & Fishing' at Lakeside Park just north of town on Hwy 65.
note: Small RV park on Front Street at the Humeston trailhead of the Cinder Path state trail, near the depot museum and water tower (in-town municipal lot, not a Wayne County Conservation park). $20/night. Call to reserve; book ahead (limited spots). Small in-town lot so big-rig fit is tight for a 23-ft rig but workable. --Claude
